# Nie Chang: Extended Research Profile

> Detailed public context for understanding and citing the academic work of Nie Chang (聂畅). Canonical human-readable source: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/

## Identity and Affiliation

Nie Chang is a final-year Ph.D. student at the School of Automation and Intelligent Sensing, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, advised by Prof. Hesheng Wang. Nie Chang is affiliated with Shanghai Jiao Tong University and the IRMV Lab. This research connects language and multimodal perception with physical action, with the long-term goal of building adaptable robot systems that learn from sparse teaching, reason over physical feedback, and reuse experience across tasks.

Research interests:

- Physical AI & Embodied Intelligence
- Agentic Robot System
- Large Language Model (LLM) & Vision Language Model (VLM)
- Vision-Language-Action Model (VLA)

Profiles and contact:

- Website: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/
- Chinese website: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/
- Email: changniep@gmail.com
- Google Scholar: https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=Tc2sl7gAAAAJ
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chang-nie-819a463b6/

## Education

- Ph.D., Physical AI and Embodied Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Shanghai, China, 2022–2026 (expected). Expected graduation: December 31, 2026. Advisor: Prof. Hesheng Wang.
- M.Eng., Computer Vision and Autonomous Driving, Beihang University, Beijing, China, 2019–2022.
- B.Eng., Vehicle Engineering, Wuhan University of Technology, Wuhan, China, 2015–2019.

## Research Program

The research covers robot decisions from multimodal observations and learning from execution experience. It studies reusable skills from sparse demonstrations, sound and memory for manipulation, and consistent multi-view training data. Related work includes visual geometry and self-supervised denoising.

HEAR and Teach and Grow are the two current representative systems. HEAR introduces continuous sound-aware manipulation. Teach and Grow organizes demonstrations, tools, physical feedback, skills, and memory so that a robot system can accumulate reusable capabilities.

## Engineering Project Record

### Multi-Camera SfM for 4D Vision Auto-Annotation

- Context: An industry–academia collaboration with NETA Auto delivering an industrial-grade 4D vision auto-annotation workflow into production.
- Wider system: Data preparation and synchronization, semantic perception, multi-sensor localization, static and ground reconstruction, ground-element auto-annotation, and multi-run local-map construction.
- Leadership and focus: Nie Chang led the overall technical route, module coordination, acceptance loop, and engineering delivery, with deep hands-on work on the SfM/static-reconstruction core and downstream geometry interfaces.
- Inputs and outputs: Six-view surround imagery, localization, semantic masks, and initial calibration were converted into refined vehicle poses and camera extrinsics, sparse scene geometry, and dense ground point clouds for downstream reconstruction.
- Engineering focus: Semantically masked SuperPoint features, overlap- and time-constrained matching, two-view verification, rig-aware registration and bundle adjustment, ACMP depth with COLMAP fusion, spatial filtering, and multi-run aggregation.
- Validation: Slashed processing latency by 95%+ (from 30-40 min down to 1-1.5 min), achieved 4.7695% mean dense-depth error against LiDAR reference (well within the 8% OEM threshold), and reduced trajectory angular drift by 3x across all evaluation sequences.
- Project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/sfm/
- Chinese project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/projects/sfm/
- Related paper: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/mrasfm/

### Automated Valet Parking: Complete Campus-Scale AVP System

- Context: Full-stack L4 autonomous valet parking program deployed with Voyager Intelligent Systems across campus environments and complex multi-floor underground garages.
- Wider system: Human–machine interaction, four-camera surround and ultrasonic perception, BEV multi-task inference, fusion localization, layered semantic mapping, hierarchical driving/parking planning, lateral and longitudinal control, and remote summon.
- Leadership and focus: Nie Chang served as project lead and chief architect for system design, module interfaces, milestones, and vehicle integration, with a deep technical focus on planning and control.
- Planning design: Centerline-guided improved A* and local state sampling handled aisle driving; orientation-aware Hybrid A* initialized a constrained optimal-control problem for executable parking trajectories.
- Operating modes: Known-map parking, remembered or assigned spaces, unknown-map exploration and mapping, park-in/out, and remote summon to a pickup point.
- Project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/avp/
- Chinese project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/projects/avp/

### Autonomous Lawn Robot: LiDAR Obstacle Perception and Multi-Sensor Fusion

- Context: Commercial-grade autonomous mower deployed across unstructured turf environments in collaboration with Positec (WORX).
- Wider system: Multi-camera and RGB-D sensing, LiDAR, RTK/GNSS, IMU, wheel odometry, onboard GPU compute, multi-sensor localization, perception, planning, and control.
- Leadership and focus: Nie Chang led the system design, module coordination, and field integration, with deep hands-on work on terrain-aware LiDAR obstacle detection and the multi-sensor obstacle-fusion layer.
- Point-cloud design: Structured grid/range projection, local terrain reasoning for grass and slopes, 7cm trench hazard detection, efficient clustering, odometry-linked temporal reuse, obstacle tracking, and planning-facing publication.
- Fusion design: Point-cloud geometry was projected into semantic masks and visual detections, producing geometry-only, class-aware, and vision-estimated obstacle types.
- Project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/mower/
- Chinese project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/projects/mower/

### Low-Speed Autonomous Research Vehicle

- Period: 2019–2022.
- Contribution: Nie Chang built an autonomous driving research vehicle from the ground up across low-speed vehicles and 4-wheel-independent-steering (4WIS) AGVs.
- Hardware: Camera, LiDAR, RTK GNSS, IMU, ultrasonic sensing, industrial computer, HMI, and drive-by-wire/CAN interfaces.
- Software: Complete ROS-based perception, GPS/map localization, decision and planning, control, and CAN communication.
- Demonstrations: Eight successful real-vehicle demonstrations covering LiDAR mapping, SLAM and RTK route following, lane keeping, multi-object detection, AEB, automatic parking, and connected ACC.
- Project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/lsv/
- Chinese project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/projects/lsv/

## Publication Record

### Towards the Vision-Sound-Language-Action Paradigm: The HEAR Framework for Sound-Centric Manipulation

- Authors: Nie Chang; Tianchen Deng; Guangming Wang; Zhe Liu; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR).
- Summary: HEAR formalizes Vision-Sound-Language-Action as a continuous robot-control paradigm. It combines causal audio memory, multimodal reasoning, near-future audio prediction, flow-matching action generation, OpenX-Sound pretraining data, HEAR-Bench evaluation, and real-robot demonstrations.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/hear/
- Project: https://hear.irmv.top/
- Code: https://github.com/IRMVLab/HEAR
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.16086

### Teach and Grow: An Agent-Centered Architecture for General Robot Learning

- Authors: Nie Chang; Zhe Liu; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue and status: Under review at IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO).
- Summary: An agent-centered robot-learning architecture that turns sparse successful demonstrations into reusable Skill Blocks and persistent experience. A multimodal agent grounds and composes skills, chooses between learned and geometric tools, observes physical outcomes, repairs execution, and stores successful behaviors, failures, and repairs for later reuse.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/tgl/
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.17209

### ERMV: Editing 4D Robotic Multi-view Images to Enhance Embodied Agents

- Authors: Nie Chang; Guangming Wang; Zhe Liu; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue and status: Under review at IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT).
- Summary: ERMV edits complete multi-view robot trajectories from sparse frame edits and robot-state conditions. Epipolar motion-aware attention, sparse spatio-temporal modeling, and multimodal feedback support consistent and efficient embodied-data augmentation.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/ermv/
- Code: https://github.com/IRMVLab/ERMV
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.17462

### MID: A Self-Supervised Multimodal Iterative Denoising Framework

- Authors: Nie Chang; Tianchen Deng; Zhe Liu; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems (TNNLS).
- DOI: 10.1109/TNNLS.2026.3683544.
- Summary: MID treats noisy observations as intermediate states in a nonlinear corruption process and learns an iterative reverse process from noisy data alone. The same formulation is instantiated across vision, biomedical signals, point sets, and biological sequences.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/mid/
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.00997

### MRASfM: Multi-Camera Reconstruction and Aggregation through Structure-from-Motion in Driving Scenes

- Authors: Nie Chang (equal contribution); Lingfeng Xuan (equal contribution); Yiqing Xu; Zhe Liu; Yanzi Miao; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA 2026).
- Summary: A multi-camera structure-from-motion framework that uses fixed inter-camera geometry, semantic road-plane filtering, camera-set bundle adjustment, and coarse-to-fine association to reconstruct and aggregate driving scenes reliably and efficiently.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/mrasfm/
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.15467

### Voxelized 3D Gaussian Representation for Dense Visual SLAM on Embedded Vision System

- Authors: Tianchen Deng; Chang Nie; Shuhong Liu; Wenhua Wu; Jianfei Yang; Shenghai Yuan; Jiuming Liu; Zhe Liu; Danwei Wang; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue and status: Accepted by the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV) in 2026.
- Summary: A voxel-anchored 3D Gaussian representation for dense visual SLAM that reduces redundant primitives with an online sliding-window mask and residual vector quantization, while combining local-to-global bundle adjustment with ICP for embedded deployment.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/vcgs-slam/
- Code: https://github.com/dtc111111/VCGS-SLAM
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.11247

### MovSAM: A Single-image Moving Object Segmentation Framework Based on Deep Thinking

- Authors: Nie Chang; Yiqing Xu; Guangming Wang; Zhe Liu; Yanzi Miao; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2025).
- DOI: 10.1109/IROS60139.2025.11246064.
- Summary: MovSAM pioneers single-image moving-object segmentation without optical flow or adjacent frames. Powered by MLLM Deep Thinking and SAM2 feature aggregation, it scores 92.5 J&F to decisively outperform multi-frame video baselines, providing a zero-shot, open-vocabulary spatial perception foundation for embodied robotics.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/movsam/
- Code: https://github.com/IRMVLab/MovSAM
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.06863

### DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation

- Authors: Nie Chang; Guangming Wang; Zhe Liu; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue and status: Under review at the International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV).
- Summary: A geometry-conditioned diffusion model learns to generate effective minimum sets for consensus-based robust estimation, iteratively refining point confidence and proposing a compact set of high-quality candidates across multiple fitting and geometric-estimation tasks.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/diffsac/
- Code: https://github.com/IRMVLab/DiffSAC
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.30603

### RLSAC: Reinforcement Learning Enhanced Sample Consensus for End-to-End Robust Estimation

- Authors: Nie Chang (equal contribution); Guangming Wang (equal contribution); Zhe Liu; Luca Cavalli; Marc Pollefeys; Hesheng Wang.
- Venue: IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV 2023).
- Summary: RLSAC casts sample-consensus robust estimation as an unsupervised Markov decision process, developed in close collaboration with Prof. Marc Pollefeys' group at ETH Zürich. A graph neural network encodes observations, residuals, and sampling history, breaking the combinatorial complexity bottleneck of classical RANSAC under severe outlier contamination.
- Page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/rlsac/
- Code: https://github.com/IRMVLab/RLSAC
- Preprint: https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.05318

## Robotic Chemist for AI for Science

- Personal responsibility: Nie Chang led the dual-arm manipulation system, focusing on high-precision grasping, delicate labware transfer, millimeter-level aligned placement, and sim-to-real transfer.
- Scope: Dual-arm mobile manipulation for automated AI for Science chemistry laboratories.
- Demonstrations: Delicate beaker transfer, slender-object grasping, tube rack placement, and centrifuge workstation operations.
- Research route: 3D Gaussian Splatting digital twins, human-to-robot demonstration mapping, few-shot skill learning, simulation-to-reality transfer, and hierarchical planning.
- Project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/robot-chemist/
- Chinese project page: https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/projects/robot-chemist/

## Factory Material Handling

- [Dual-arm mobile material handling](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/projects/factory-material-handling/): Heavy-payload industrial mobile manipulation system achieving sub-centimeter pallet localization, millimeter-level 6D pose estimation, and synchronized dual-arm de-palletizing under extreme factory vibrations. Nie Chang spearheaded pose estimation and dual-arm coordination.
- [工厂搬运机器人](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/projects/factory-material-handling/): 工业级重载双臂自主移动操作平台，攻克毫米级位姿估计与振动干扰下双臂协同拆垛难题。

- [DTFI: LiDAR-camera fusion and IMM-UKF tracking (TETCI 2023)](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/publications/dtfi/): Chang Nie, Zhiyang Ju, Zhifeng Sun, Hui Zhang. 30 Hz real-time highway perception with deep feature fusion and IMM-UKF tracking, achieving 86.00% Mostly Tracked (MT) and sub-1% Mostly Lost (ML) on KITTI. DOI: 10.1109/TETCI.2023.3259441. [中文](https://biubiu3.github.io/web-cv/zh/publications/dtfi/).
